_comment: Manually maintained -- unlike league-814682-watch.json, there is no live FPL API this workflow can poll to auto-sync a squad (that requires the manager's own team endpoint, which needs auth this workflow doesn't have). Update this file by hand whenever a real transfer/chip decision changes the squad. Consumed by .github/workflows/scout-watch.yml's verification step to flag findings about players actually in this squad.
note: Kroupi was swapped out for Rogers earlier this season; the exact bench order/composition above may have shifted slightly since last_updated_at -- treat starting_xi and captain as the highest-confidence fields.
